description: This file defines the 'Invoice' class for the vtiger CRM system, including properties, methods for saving, retrieving related activities and history, and handling recurring invoices. It includes module-specific logic and database interactions pertinent to invoice management within the system.

classes.name: Invoice
classes.description: Represents an invoice entity in vtiger CRM with methods for CRUD operations, related records, and custom logic specific to invoices.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles module-specific save operations, including updating sales order status and creating recurring invoices from sales orders.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name or summary text of the invoice object.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activities related to the invoice, such as tasks or meetings.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Fetches the activity history related to the invoice.

methods.name: get_invoicestatushistory
methods.description: Retrieves the history of status changes for the invoice.

methods.name: get_column_value
methods.description: Overrides parent method to handle specific column value processing, e.g., sales order ID.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates a secondary query part for reports involving related modules.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Defines relation tables for related modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Unlinks or deletes relationships between the invoice and other records.

methods.name: createRecurringInvoiceFromSO
methods.description: Creates a recurring invoice based on a sales order, copying product details, updating stock, and other related data.
